summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K to respond to Brazilian press reports that it was evaluating an investment in an iron ore asset in Corumbá. The Company clarified that although it regularly assesses investment opportunities, it has ruled out any investment related to that specific asset. No transaction details, terms, parties, or structural mechanics were disclosed. This is a routine market clarification with no binding agreement, recommendation, or deal mechanics. It does not constitute a special situation event; it is merely a denial of speculative reports. No event is actionable, and there is no risk-arb angle to monitor.
